scope: High Mountain Asia Glaciated Terrain & Moraine Dams

full_scene_archive_scenario.mode_description: Full-scene Sentinel-1 SLC download (~4.2 GB zip per acquisition)
full_scene_archive_scenario.recommendation: Full-scene SLC download requires 938.8 GB, exceeding local budget 106.2 GB by 832.6 GB. Provider-side burst cropping or GRD amplitude + spatial variance pipeline must be utilized instead.

burst_cropped_scenario.mode_description: Provider-side burst cropping / sub-setting (<= 1.0 GB per lake ROI)
burst_cropped_scenario.recommendation: Full-scene SLC download requires 223.5 GB, exceeding local budget 106.2 GB by 117.3 GB. Provider-side burst cropping or GRD amplitude + spatial variance pipeline must be utilized instead.

steep_headwall_layover.explanation: Terrain slope (45.0 deg) exceeds nominal incidence angle (38.0 deg) on radar-facing slope. Top of ridge returns signal before base, causing radar layover and phase inversion.

backslope_radar_shadow.explanation: Backslope facing away from radar beam (local incidence 93.0 deg >= 90 deg). Surface is obscured from radar line-of-sight, resulting in complete signal loss (radar shadow).

gentle_outwash_foreshortening.explanation: Terrain slope (8.0 deg) faces radar, compressing slant-range pixel resolution (foreshortening).

monsoon_moraine_12day.implication: Severe decorrelation (gamma=0.0176 < 0.3). Phase noise precludes reliable interferometric deformation extraction; SAR GRD amplitude and spatial texture features must be prioritized.

monsoon_moraine_6day.implication: Severe decorrelation (gamma=0.1304 < 0.3). Phase noise precludes reliable interferometric deformation extraction; SAR GRD amplitude and spatial texture features must be prioritized.

architectural_recommendation.selected_modality: SAR GRD Linear Power + Spatial Texture
architectural_recommendation.justification: Due to pervasive monsoon decorrelation (gamma < 0.25) and radar layover/shadow on moraine headwalls, multi-temporal InSAR phase unwrapping cannot provide continuous pre-event monitoring. Calibrated dual-pol GRD amplitude (VV, VH, cross-ratio) combined with spatial variance provides unbroken, physically robust observational coverage.
